title: Why Putin’s first Kuril Islands visit matters as Russia-Japan ties hit new low
content: Russian President Vladimir Putin visited the disputed Kuril Islands for the first time.  This visit occurred amid deeply strained relations between Russia and Japan.  Japan strongly protests the visit, reiterating its territorial claims over the islands.  The long-standing dispute has intensified since Russia's invasion of Ukraine.  This territorial disagreement prevents a formal World War II peace treaty.

title: Months after Dells' $6.25bn ‘gift’, US Treasury sets new Trump Account paycheck rules
content: Under the new guidelines for Trump Accounts, both employers and employees can make contributions towards payrolls. Employers are permitted to add up to $2,500 annually without tax for dependent children, while employees can contribute pre-tax funds directly from their paychecks. In support of this initiative, Michael and Susan Dell committed $6.25 billion to boost child savings. The proposal is currently open for public feedback prior to its finalization.

title: Dog parents were right: Dogs can tell when you're sad, scared or angry
content: New research confirms dogs can differentiate human emotions through facial expressions.  Their brains process happy faces in a unique reward region, showing emotional significance.  Dogs also distinguish between fear, anger, and sadness with distinct brain activity patterns.  This ability developed through domestication, aiding their social understanding of humans.  Understanding these emotions does not mean dogs experience them identically to people.

title: Jamie Dimon to Gen Z: You could be forgiven for giving up on the American Dream

He stresses, however, that this dream is still attainable for most individuals, despite some experiencing stagnant incomes. To address this, Dimon pointed out JPMorgan's proactive measures to enhance opportunities via skills training and business assistance.

title: Haryana youth who served in French Army stabbed to death in Germany

He had previously served in the French Army for about a year.  After leaving the army, he moved to Germany and worked in deliveries.  The family awaits details about the circumstances and motive for the killing.

title: DDA releases 1,224 flats under Karmajeevi Awaas Yojana, with a 25% discount

This incident has prompted discussions about banning aggressive dog breeds in the city.

title: Months after ‘suicide’ video, Gujarat man kills estranged wife in US

It also could not explain two fund transfers made from the account. The consumer commission upheld the payout after the bank's appeal was dismissed. This decision followed the bank's service deficiency in handling the complaint.
